blockers.reason: Current production successor is #3142 exact f4863bded2f9ca9b41f1e5d17c3f37a592efbe3f on defeated #3056@b8653985. It correctly replaces the old supplementary-capability-GID/process-group DerivedData topology with a dedicated UID/GID + zero supplementary groups + writable APFS output, normal non-forced quiescence before result interpretation, read-only remount/explicit EROFS proof, frozen-source fingerprint, root-owned no-ACL stage, and exact staged fingerprint equality. Independent reviews 4914432389 and 4914440707 found one remaining blocking lifecycle defect: _remove_local_build_identity uses unchecked pkill/dscl cleanup and no user/group-absence postcondition, so a nominally successful build can return an accepted stage without mechanically proving the hidden build principal retired. Make successful promotion fail closed on verified principal retirement and add a failure-path regression before accepting this successor. PHYSICAL NO-GO.

Validation-only #3131 exact 98fdc404048812f6d3af6791710c57ece21dafd3 is accepted architecture evidence. Real-macOS run 31547634222 is terminal SUCCESS and independently binds the dedicated build UID/GID across sudo identity replay while proving normal non-forced APFS detach, byte-identical read-only remount, and field/root/former-build mutation denial with physicalAuthorityCreated=false. #3142 deliberately consumes this architecture; validation green never substitutes for #3142 production acceptance.

Ancestor #3142@da41 Field run 31577350832 failed exactly at a stale source assertion requiring os.chmod(derived, 0o770), while private Tuya provenance and signed Apple application-identity source checks passed. Current f486 changes only capture-field-build-provenance.yml to require the new dedicated UID/APFS/quiescence/read-only-remount contract and reject the retired capability/process-group design. Source review accepts that oracle change, but exact f486 Field run 31577777848 is queued at this checkpoint and cannot be promoted before terminal success. Ancestor green/red is supporting evidence only after the head move.

#3142 still executes the real private Tuya build-window guard plus Automatic Apple signing/provisioning inside the dedicated build identity. The canonical Signed Install real-Xcode oracle proves compiler-output/APFS custody but deliberately does not prove access to the field user's mode-restricted Tuya inputs, Apple Development keychain identity, provisioning updates/device registration, or final signed iOS workspace. If real signed field feasibility is red, introduce a narrower custodied input/signing handoff; do not restore field-user writable compiler-output authority merely to obtain green.

After #3142 earns exact production acceptance and real signed/private feasibility, signed-install still must converge with current selected-Xcode/build authority, accepted private identity plus its source-root consumer seam, Final-GO Darwin authority, runtime accessibility and the accepted app-visible Capture product on one unchanged exact composition. Re-run protected-stage, signature/profile/CoreDevice, Field/Main/Xcode, adversarial and final procedure gates there. No validation or package-only result authorizes installation or scooter interaction.
